params.prompt:
Revise the performance and pacing of this business meeting. Keep the same woman and man, their wardrobe, office, daylight, visual realism and coherent spatial relationship.

Spend most of the scene in the ease and energy of a meeting that is going well. She enjoys explaining a business she knows thoroughly; he responds with friendly professional curiosity. Let the conversation breathe, with relaxed posture, responsive expressions, occasional brief smiles and spontaneous back-and-forth. The financial review has gone well and both remain comfortable.

The buyer's practical question about how the business runs during her month away grows naturally from that positive conversation later in the scene. She begins answering just as readily, then discovers the difficulty while explaining. Her words trail off and her lips close as she thinks through the answer. Keep the emotional change small: her composure remains intact and the buyer stays patient and interested. Finish on a brief, thoughtful, unresolved pause. Avoid a distressed or frightened expression and a prolonged dramatic stare.

This is an illustrative enacted scene beneath an existing narrator: conversational mouth movement is welcome. Keep the output silent, with no character audio, narration, music or on-screen text.
